payload.title: Bootstrap del monorepo Bun + TypeScript
payload.description:
Crear la estructura del monorepo (`apps/server`, `apps/web`, `apps/cli`, `apps/mcp`, `packages/schema`) con Bun workspaces, TypeScript estricto y scripts base (`bun run server`, `bun test`).

**Entregable:** repo que instala y corre un server hello-world con `bun run server`. Spec de referencia: [`docs/specs/mvp.md`](<https://github.com/andrestobelem/prime-board/blob/main/docs/specs/mvp.md>).
